reports.description: This is a blackmail scam. The sender claims to have been watching me on my computer for months via malware that he/she updates every four hours to avoid detection. The sender claims to have recorded video of me visiting an adult website and threatens to send the video to an unspecified number of people on an unspecified contact list unless I pay $782 within 48 hours. The sender included the final two digits of what I suspect is supposed to be a bank card number, but it matches none of mine. Also, I use an external monitor that has no camera, so Im pretty sure Ive not been recorded. Still, as another person wrote, its unsettling to get such a thing.

Scammer claimed to have infected my computer with a virus when I visited a porn site. Claimed that the virus was undetectable since it mutates every 4 hours. The scammer claimed that video had been created with me on the lefts side of the screen pleasing myself and with the right side of the screen showing the porn I was watching.  
_x000D_
Scammer wanted a deposit $901 in Bitcoin to his Bitcoin Wallet within 48 hours or the video would be released to all of my contacts._x000D_
_x000D_
Problem is that I do not have a webcam on my external monitors. I do have one on my laptop but the lid is always closed. I do leave my iPhone facing upward or downward, plugged in for charging to my PC. So, I placed my iPhone in face up and face down positions with the camera in the selfie and standard forward mode. But my camera cannot see me in either configuration and can only see no more than 20% top of my monitor anywhere I place it on the desk.
